request: Add environment self-healing to the executor. If a command fails due to missing dependencies (e.g., pytest), automatically install them using 'python -m pip install <package>' and retry the command once. If installation fails, return a clear error. Do not loop indefinitely. Ensure this logic applies to all run_command steps.
title: Implement environment self-healing in executor
goals: Detect missing dependencies when a command fails in the executor
Automatically install missing dependencies using 'python -m pip install <package>'
Retry the failed command once after installing dependencies
Return a clear error message if dependency installation fails
constraints: Do not loop indefinitely on command retries
Ensure the self-healing logic applies to all run_command steps
success_criteria: The executor retries a command once after installing missing dependencies
A clear error message is returned if dependency installation fails
No infinite loops occur during command retries
